title: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
title_zh: GUI-JEPA：候选条件化的JEPA潜在表示作为移动GUI智能体的快速动作策略

paragraphs.en: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8–4.0 × \times faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86–92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA .
paragraphs.zh: 移动 GUI 智能体通常是经过微调的 7B 规模视觉-语言模型（VLM），以文本形式生成每个动作。 然而，这些 VLM 逐 token 解码每个动作，即使是那些对候选动作进行打分的智能体，也需要将大型语言模型或 VLM 置于循环中，导致速度慢且内存占用高。 为解决这些问题，我们提出 GUI-JEPA，据我们所知，这是首个基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）构建的无解码器 GUI 智能体策略，它在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）编码器的潜在空间中选择动作，该编码器在无标注的 GUI 截图上进行了预训练。 其以动作和区域为条件的潜在预测器将屏幕潜在表示转换为每个候选动作对应的一个潜在表示，使轻量级打分头能够在单次批量处理中根据指令对所有候选动作进行打分，而无需解码任何 token。 我们进一步证明，打分器依赖于这条潜在通路，且预测器是为决策本身而训练的：随机初始化的预测器与在屏幕动态上预训练的预测器表现相当。 在 AndroidControl 上，在相同 GPU 上，GUI-JEPA 比我们用相同输入微调的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 智能体快 2.8–4.0 × \times 倍，同时以 6% 的参数量达到其分布内准确率的 86–92%。 代码可在 https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA 获取。

paragraphs.en: A mobile graphical user interface (GUI) agent’s per-step cost is dominated by a 7B+ vision-language model (VLM) decoding its action token by token. On one NVIDIA H20, a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent ( Bai et al., 2025 ) LoRA-fine-tuned ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on AndroidControl needs 207 ms per step under vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and 507 ms under Hugging Face (HF) transformers to emit a JSON action of ∼ {\sim} 12 tokens (median over 100 real steps, batch 1; Table 3 ), and 8B-class agents average 2.6–10.6 s per step in a live-device benchmark ( Sui et al., 2026 ) . Yet in GUI grounding a VLM fixes its target elements during prefill, with decoding only refining coordinates ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , and decoding on the critical path makes agents correct but late ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . Could a GUI agent score its actions in the latent space of a joint-embedding predictive architecture ( Assran et al., 2023 , JEPA;) , without decoding them at all?
paragraphs.zh: 移动端图形用户界面（GUI）智能体的每步开销主要来自一个 7B+ 视觉语言模型（VLM）逐 token 解码其动作。 在单块 NVIDIA H20 上，经 AndroidControl 上 LoRA 微调（Hu et al., 2022）的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 智能体（Bai et al., 2025），在 vLLM（Kwon et al., 2023）下输出一个约 {\sim} 12 token 的 JSON 动作需要每步 207 毫秒，在 Hugging Face（HF）transformers 下需要每步 507 毫秒（100 个真实步骤的中位数，batch 1；见表 3），而在真实设备基准测试（Sui et al., 2026）中，8B 级智能体平均每步耗时 2.6–10.6 秒。 然而，在 GUI 定位（grounding）中，VLM 在预填充阶段就已确定目标元素，解码只是细化坐标（Lin et al., 2026a），而将解码置于关键路径上会使智能体正确却迟缓（Dong et al., 2026）。 GUI 智能体能否在联合嵌入预测架构（Assran et al., 2023，JEPA）的潜空间中为其动作打分，而完全不进行解码？

paragraphs.en: GUI world models generate pixels, code or text and serve an LLM policy as simulator or verifier ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Mei et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) , or as a pretraining target ( Liu et al., 2026b ) . On GUIs, JEPAs have so far served understanding and verification: UI-JEPA describes user intent through an LLM decoder ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , LGWM verifies GUI transitions ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and next-frame feature prediction regularises the training of a VLM agent ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . Candidate scorers over the accessibility tree (a11y) keep an LLM or VLM in the loop ( Dai et al., 2026 ; Zhang, 2026 ; Christianos et al., 2025 ) , and Agentic-JEPA, which acts with a JEPA, is text-only with 0% out-of-distribution (OOD) success ( Rodrigo-Ginés, 2026 ) . To our knowledge, no GUI agent has yet used a JEPA as the policy that selects its actions.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 世界模型生成像素、代码或文本，作为 LLM 策略的模拟器或验证器（Luo et al., 2026；Zheng et al., 2026；Mei et al., 2026；Cao et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026b），或作为预训练目标（Liu et al., 2026b）。 在 GUI 领域，JEPA 迄今主要用于理解与验证：UI-JEPA 通过 LLM 解码器描述用户意图（Fu et al., 2025），LGWM 验证 GUI 状态转移（Zhang et al., 2026a），而下一帧特征预测则用于正则化 VLM 智能体的训练（Yang et al., 2026b）。 基于无障碍树（a11y）的候选打分器让 LLM 或 VLM 保持在决策回路中（Dai et al., 2026；Zhang, 2026；Christianos et al., 2025），而与 JEPA 协同行动的 Agentic-JEPA 仅支持纯文本，分布外（OOD）成功率为 0%（Rodrigo-Ginés, 2026）。 据我们所知，目前尚无 GUI 智能体将 JEPA 用作选择动作的策略。

paragraphs.en: We bring JEPAs from perception and robotics to GUI control, moving action selection from the decoder into the latent space of a frozen JEPA encoder. GUI-JEPA encodes the screenshot once with a JEPA ViT-L pretrained on GUI screenshots, transforms that latent once per candidate (a11y element or global action) with a 39.9M residual predictor conditioned on the candidate’s action and region of interest (ROI), scores the candidate-conditioned latents with a cosine structural head, adds a 33M text-matcher score and takes the argmax, all in one batched pass ( Figure 2 ). As in earlier candidate-scoring agents, the candidates come from the a11y tree, but GUI-JEPA never generates a token, so the cost of a step depends on how many candidates it scores.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 JEPA 从感知与机器人领域引入 GUI 控制，把动作选择从解码器转移到冻结 JEPA 编码器的潜空间中。 GUI-JEPA 使用在 GUI 截图上预训练的 JEPA ViT-L 对截图编码一次，再由一个 39.9M 参数、以候选（a11y 元素或全局动作）的动作和感兴趣区域（ROI）为条件的残差预测器对潜表示按候选变换一次，用余弦结构头对以候选为条件的潜表示打分，加上一个 33M 参数文本匹配器的分数并取 argmax，全部在单次批量前向中完成（图 2）。 与早期的候选打分智能体一样，候选来自 a11y 树，但 GUI-JEPA 从不生成任何 token，因此一步的开销取决于它打分的候选数量。

paragraphs.en: Adapting a JEPA policy to GUIs: a11y candidates as actions, ROI- and action-conditioned residual prediction, a structural head whose only candidate-dependent visual input is the conditioned latent, and two text rankers that together add 3.8 out-of-distribution AC-High points ( Table 2 ).

paragraphs.en: Closest in input are the a11y-text PaLM 2S baselines of AndroidControl ( Section 4.2 ). GUI-JEPA shares a11y enumeration and argmax but scores a candidate-conditioned JEPA latent plus a 33M text matcher, with no generative model in the loop.

paragraphs.en: In robotics, latent world models built on joint-embedding predictive architectures ( Assran et al., 2023 ; Assran et al., 2025 ) plan ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Maes et al., 2026 ; Zholus et al., 2026 ) or drive action policies ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . On GUIs, UI-JEPA feeds a JEPA-pretrained video encoder into a fine-tuned LLM decoder that describes user intent, with a reported 6.6 × \times lower latency than Claude 3.5 Sonnet on IIW ( Fu et al., 2025 ) ; the concurrent LGWM, a JEPA over GUI transitions, verifies whether an observed transition is expected ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , RSI-Anything’s world-model predictions rank actions that a separate policy proposes ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , and next-frame feature alignment serves as a training-time regulariser discarded at inference ( Yang et al., 2026b ) ; the recent Agentic-JEPA picks actions by the cosine between predicted next-state and goal embeddings in synthetic text-only environments (100% success in distribution, 0% out of distribution) ( Rodrigo-Ginés, 2026 ) . Decision-aligned work finds that the latent closest to the goal need not be the best action ( Liu et al., 2026a ) and that predictors can ignore the action ( Gan et al., 2026 ) ; value-equivalent models likewise learn latents for planning without a reconstruction objective ( Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ) . In GUI-JEPA the JEPA is the policy itself: it scores a11y candidates through candidate-conditioned latents of a frozen GUI-pretrained encoder, with no decoder, whereas earlier GUI work uses a JEPA to describe intent, verify transitions or regularise training. Our mechanism result ( Section 5.1 ) adds a GUI-domain data point to work finding that predictability and action relevance come apart ( Gu et al., 2026 ) and to work that trains world models for the decision ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在机器人学中，基于联合嵌入预测架构（Assran et al., 2023；Assran et al., 2025）构建的潜在世界模型被用于规划（Zhou et al., 2025a；Maes et al., 2026；Zholus et al., 2026）或驱动动作策略（Sun et al., 2026；Lin et al., 2026b；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 在图形用户界面（GUI）方面，UI-JEPA 将经 JEPA 预训练的视频编码器接入一个微调的 LLM 解码器来描述用户意图，据报道其在 IIW 上的延迟比 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 低 6.6 × \times 倍（Fu et al., 2025）；同时期的 LGWM 是一个作用于 GUI 状态转移的 JEPA，用于验证观察到的转移是否符合预期（Zhang et al., 2026a）；RSI-Anything 用其世界模型的预测对由独立策略提出的动作进行排序（Cui et al., 2026）；而下一帧特征对齐则作为一种仅在训练时使用、在推理时被丢弃的正则化手段（Yang et al., 2026b）；近期的 Agentic-JEPA 在仅含合成文本的环境中通过预测的下一状态嵌入与目标嵌入之间的余弦相似度来选择动作（分布内成功率 100%，分布外成功率 0%）（Rodrigo-Ginés, 2026）。 与决策对齐的研究发现，离目标最近的潜在表征未必对应最优动作（Liu et al., 2026a），且预测器可能忽略动作本身（Gan et al., 2026）；价值等价模型同样在不依赖重建目标的情况下学习用于规划的潜在表征（Schrittwieser et al., 2020）。 在 GUI-JEPA 中，JEPA 本身就是策略：它通过冻结的 GUI 预训练编码器所产生的、以候选为条件的潜在表征来对无障碍候选进行打分，且不使用解码器；而此前面向 GUI 的工作则将 JEPA 用于描述意图、验证状态转移或对训练进行正则化。 我们的机制性结果（第 5.1 节）为「可预测性与动作相关性并不一致」这一发现（Gu et al., 2026），以及为面向决策训练世界模型的研究（Li et al., 2026），补充了一个 GUI 领域的数据点。

paragraphs.en: GUI-JEPA chooses each action by scoring candidates. At every step it enumerates the executable actions from the a11y tree, embeds the screenshot once with a frozen JEPA encoder, transforms that screen latent once per candidate with a residual predictor, scores each candidate-conditioned latent and the candidate’s text against the text condition, and executes the highest-scoring candidate ( Figure 2 ). paragraphs.zh: GUI-JEPA 通过对候选动作打分来选择每个动作。 在每一步，它会从无障碍树中枚举可执行的动作，用冻结的 JEPA 编码器对截图进行一次嵌入，用残差预测器对每个候选动作将该屏幕隐表示变换一次，将每个以候选动作为条件的隐表示以及候选动作的文本与文本条件进行打分，并执行得分最高的候选动作（图 2）。 由于不生成任何 token、像素或代码行，一次决策就是一次批量前向传播，其开销随候选动作数量的增加而增长。

paragraphs.en: Element-level candidates are the visible a11y nodes flagged clickable, long-clickable, editable or scrollable, capped at the 80 smallest by area, which keeps specific elements and bounds the batch; each carries the text of the node and its descendants, its bounding box and its type. Every enumerated node yields a click candidate, and every editable node also an input_text candidate whose text is filled in by the span ranker ( Section 3.4 ). paragraphs.en: Training has three stages (circled numbers in Figure 2 ): JEPA pretraining of the encoder ( Section 3.2 ), policy training, and the two text rankers. The base policy (predictor, structural head and text matcher, trained jointly; encoder and CLIP text encoder frozen) is trained on the 13,594 cached episodes (74,714 steps) of the 13,604-episode AndroidControl training split with a listwise cross-entropy over the candidates of each step, ℒ t = − w t ​ log ⁡ p t ​ ( c t ∗ ) \mathcal{L}_{t}=-w_{t}\log p_{t}(c^{*}_{t}) with p t = softmax c ∈ 𝒞 t ⁡ s ⁡ ( c ) p_{t}=\softmax_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{t}}s(c) , where c t ∗ c^{*}_{t} is the ground-truth candidate and w t = 1.5 w_{t}{=}1.5 for non-click steps and 1 for clicks, which offsets the predominance of clicks. The objective matches inference, where the recorded action must outscore every alternative the policy could take on that screen. We train with AdamW for 6 epochs, one model for both AC-Low and AC-High (hyperparameters: Table 13 ), and fine-tune the predictor jointly, which outperforms freezing it ( Section 5.2 ). The two rankers are then trained on the fixed base policy. Of the 0.50B parameters, 366M are frozen (303M encoder, 63M CLIP text encoder) and ≈ {\approx} 132M trained, including the 22.7M span ranker and the 33.5M click reranker.

paragraphs.en: We test on the four official AndroidControl subsplits ( Li et al., 2024 ) : IDD (721 episodes) and the overlapping app_unseen (631), task_unseen (803) and category_unseen (700, contained in task_unseen). The 137-episode validation split selected the click reranker’s variant, weight β \beta and gate. Systems that state their split report all test subsets together, so we compare them with our full-test result and use IDD only against published IDD numbers.

paragraphs.en: AC-Low conditions on the step instruction and AC-High on the episode goal, both with the ground-truth action history. Our exact-match judge keeps the original benchmark’s click rule (the chosen candidate’s centre lies inside the ground-truth element box) and departs from the original protocol in four places: it counts no equivalent open_app or navigation actions, requires the normalised typed text to match, accepts a click for a ground-truth long_press (9 IDD steps), and takes the ground-truth box from the smallest enumerated candidate (originally the smallest a11y node), scoring clicks without a candidate (1.6–2.6%) as errors where the original discards them ( Appendix B ). Candidates come from the a11y tree, a privileged input that pixel-only agents do not use.
paragraphs.zh: 在步骤指令上施加 AC-Low 条件，在回合目标上施加 AC-High 条件，两者均使用真实动作历史。 我们的精确匹配评判器保留了原始基准的点击规则（所选候选元素的中心位于真实元素框内），并在四处偏离了原始协议：不统计等价的 open_app 或导航动作，要求归一化后的输入文本匹配，接受将点击对应真实长按操作（9 个 IDD 步骤），并采用最小枚举候选（原始协议中为最小的 a11y 节点）的真实框，把没有候选的点击（1.6–2.6%）计为错误，而原始协议会将其丢弃（附录 B）。 候选元素来自 a11y 树，这是一种纯像素智能体不会使用的特权输入。

paragraphs.en: The final GUI-JEPA pipeline (base policy, span ranker and click reranker) needs a median 74 ms per step in fp32 and 51.5 ms with bf16 autocast, against 207 ms for the 7B agent with vLLM and 507 ms with HF transformers (merged LoRA; Table 3 ). paragraphs.en: Clicks, 63% of the steps, account for 5.8 of the 9.9-point AC-High gap to the 7B agent, shared between choosing the click type and grounding the element, the part the text matcher carries ( Section 3.4 ). On global actions the gap lies mainly in the type decision, and on open_app and input_text in the argument (per type: Table 15 ). The two systems also err on different steps ( Figure 10 ): at least one of them is right on 78.7% of IDD AC-High steps, and the margin between GUI-JEPA’s top two scores flags its errors (AUROC 0.74), so uncertain steps can be routed to a same-protocol 7B agent where accuracy matters more than speed ( Appendix J ).

paragraphs.en: We lesion the trained base policy at evaluation time, text matcher untouched ( Figure 4 a; Table 5 ). On IDD, shuffling the action vectors across all candidates costs 27.2 Low / 23.4 High, shuffling them within a type 11.2 / 10.8 (mostly scroll directions; about 5 High on clicks), and replacing the candidate-conditioned latent by the current latent (no predictor) 24.9 / 14.0, mostly on the global actions, which share the full-screen ROI. The action vector reaches the structural head only through the predictor, and training cannot route around it. Retrained at full scale with the identity map in place of the predictor, the policy reaches 62.36 / 42.33, 21.4 / 14.5 points below the base policy, again on the global actions, which the identity map leaves indistinguishable ( Table 8 ). The pathway thus carries chiefly action type and scroll direction, and also helps select among clicks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在评估时对训练好的基础策略进行损伤，文本匹配器保持不变（图 4 a；表 5）。 在 IDD 上，将所有候选的动作向量打乱会损失 27.2 低 / 23.4 高，在同一类型内打乱则损失 11.2 / 10.8（主要是滚动方向；点击上约 5 高），而用当前隐向量替换候选条件隐向量（无预测器）损失 24.9 / 14.0，主要发生在共享全屏 ROI 的全局动作上。 动作向量只能通过预测器到达结构头，训练无法绕开它。 在全规模下用恒等映射替代预测器重新训练后，策略达到 62.36 / 42.33，比基础策略低 21.4 / 14.5 分，同样是在全局动作上，恒等映射使这些动作无法区分（表 8）。 因此该通路主要承载动作类型和滚动方向，同时也有助于在点击中进行选择。

paragraphs.en: A randomly initialised predictor trained with the identical full-scale recipe does as well as the dynamics-pretrained one (+0.50 High / − 1.01 -1.01 Low; Figure 4 c), and predictive auxiliary objectives (per-patch ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , pooled, multi-horizon, LeWorldModel-style ( Maes et al., 2026 ) ) add nothing at 4K-episode scale ( Table 8 ). The predictor thus learns what the decision needs, and forward-model probes show that it forecasts the next latent worse than a copy of the current one ( Appendix D ). It acts as an action- and ROI-conditioned transform of the current screen, so a JEPA policy for GUIs needs no dynamics pretraining. This agrees with findings that predictability and action relevance come apart ( Gu et al., 2026 ) and with training world models for the decision ( Li et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个使用完全相同全规模配方训练的随机初始化预测器，其表现与以动力学预训练的预测器相当（+0.50 High / − 1.01 Low；图 4 c），而各类预测性辅助目标（逐补丁的（Sun et al., 2026）、池化的、多时间跨度的、LeWorldModel 风格的（Maes et al., 2026））在 4K 回合规模下没有任何增益（表 8）。 因此，预测器学到的正是决策所需的内容，且前向模型探测显示，它对下一个潜在状态的预测反而不如直接复制当前状态（附录 D）。 它充当的是对当前屏幕的一种基于动作和 ROI 条件化的变换，因此面向 GUI 的 JEPA 策略无需动力学预训练。 这与可预测性和动作相关性相互分离的研究发现（Gu et al., 2026）以及面向决策训练世界模型的研究（Li et al., 2026）相一致。

paragraphs.en: At pilot scale without the text matcher, the residual form raises AC-Low from 40.6 to 43.9, whereas a predictor that re-synthesises the whole latent lowers AC-Low click grounding to 34.8, below the identity map’s 46.8. The structural head makes the policy use the predictor. Replacing the predictor by the identity map costs it 8.9 AC-Low points (40.6 vs 31.7), whereas a concat-MLP head that also sees raw candidate features stays within 1.4 points with or without a predictor ( Figure 4 b). Conditioning on the previous action and frame change adds 8 High points; at full scale, joint fine-tuning beats a frozen predictor by 3.8 AC-Low / 1.9 AC-High IDD points ( Figure 4 c; alternatives: Table 10 ). The encoder is cheap to obtain. After 0.76 GPU-hours of JEPA pretraining on unlabelled screenshots, its frozen tokens score 67.22 on a coarse localisation probe over ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) (probe hit@8; random-init ViT-L: 58.8), on par with DINOv3-ViT-L ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) (65.28; Figure 7 , Appendix G ). In the policy, DINOv2-L ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) features at 518 px instead cost 17.4 / 9.8 points at 4K-episode scale, though it also changes the input resolution ( Table 10 ).

paragraphs.en: GUI-JEPA consumes the a11y tree, a privileged structured input that pixel-only agents do not use; the 1.6–2.6% of test clicks without a candidate count as errors, and every latency excludes screen capture and a11y retrieval. The policy is a step-level scorer; online task completion, which needs a termination head and a planner, is left to future work, as is using the predictor as a forward model. Design choices other than the reranker’s variant, weight and gate were made on test IDD and re-checked on validation only for the span ranker and overall base-policy accuracy ( Section 4.4 ). Speed-ups are measured at batch 1 against vLLM and HF serving of the 7B agent ( Section 4.5 ). The same-protocol 7B reference is one LoRA adapter per setting trained on 4,000 of 13,594 episodes. The method is specialised to mobile a11y candidates; other candidate sources, such as web DOM nodes, need their own candidate texts and action vectors. Non-JEPA encoders are compared through a probe on the frozen tokens ( Appendix G ); a comparison inside the full-scale policy is future work.
paragraphs.zh: GUI-JEPA 消费的是 a11y 树，这是一种像素类智能体不会使用的特权结构化输入；测试中 1.6–2.6% 的点击因无候选而被计为错误，且所有时延均不包含屏幕截图与 a11y 检索。 该策略是一个步骤级打分器；在线任务完成需要终止头与规划器，将预测器用作前向模型也一并留待未来工作。 除重排器的变体、权重与门控之外的其他设计选择均基于测试 IDD 作出，并仅在验证集上对跨度排序器与整体基础策略准确率进行了复核（第 4.4 节）。 加速比是在批大小为 1 的条件下，针对 7B 智能体的 vLLM 与 HF 部署方式测得的（第 4.5 节）。 同一协议下的 7B 参照模型是每种设置各训练一个 LoRA 适配器，训练数据为 13,594 个回合中的 4,000 个。 该方法专门针对移动端 a11y 候选；其他候选来源，如 web DOM 节点，需要各自的候选文本与动作向量。 非 JEPA 编码器通过在冻结 token 上的探针进行对比（附录 G）；在全尺寸策略内部的对比则是未来工作。

paragraphs.en: GUI-JEPA lowers the cost of GUI agents that act on a user’s device. A wrong action, such as sending a message, deleting data or confirming a payment, can be hard to undo, and step-level errors remain common; a deployment needs user confirmation before irreversible actions. The speed that makes on-device agents practical also makes it cheaper to automate interactions meant for humans, such as mass account creation. The policy reads the accessibility tree, which can contain personal on-screen data; running the 0.50B model on-device keeps that data local. We use only public datasets under their licences (AndroidControl Apache-2.0, GUI-Odyssey CC-BY-4.0, VideoCUA and ScreenSpot-Pro MIT), collect no new data, and involve no human subjects, annotators or crowd workers.
paragraphs.zh: GUI-JEPA 降低了在用户设备上执行操作的智能体的成本。 错误的操作，例如发送消息、删除数据或确认支付，可能难以撤销，而步骤级别的错误仍然很常见；因此在执行不可逆操作之前，部署方案需要用户确认。 使设备端智能体变得实用的速度优势，也让自动化原本面向人类的交互（例如批量创建账户）的成本更低。 策略读取的是无障碍树，其中可能包含屏幕上的个人数据；在设备端运行 0.50B 模型可以让这些数据保留在本地。 我们仅在其许可协议下使用公开数据集（AndroidControl 为 Apache-2.0，GUI-Odyssey 为 CC-BY-4.0，VideoCUA 和 ScreenSpot-Pro 为 MIT），不收集任何新数据，也不涉及任何人类受试者、标注者或众包工作者。

paragraphs.en: The encoder is a ViT-L/16 at 224 px, initialised from ImageNet weights and trained with a JEPA objective adapted from I-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2023 ) on 189,262 unlabelled screenshots from GUI-Odyssey ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and VideoCUA ( Jian et al., 2026 ) for 2 epochs ( ≈ \approx 0.76 GPU-hour on one H20), with no action labels and no AndroidControl data ( Sections 3.2 and H ). The policy is trained on the 13,594 cached episodes of the 13,604-episode AndroidControl training split ( Li et al., 2024 ) with a listwise cross-entropy, AdamW and 6 epochs, for three seeds ( Sections 3.5 and 13 ). We evaluate on the official test subsplits with the exact-match judge of Section 4.1 and time both systems on the same 100 real IDD steps on one H20 at batch 1 ( Appendix I ).

paragraphs.en: Element-level candidates are the visible accessibility-tree (a11y) nodes flagged clickable, long-clickable, editable or scrollable, plus containers that inherit clickability, de-duplicated by bounds and capped at the 80 smallest by area; editable nodes also yield input_text candidates. Global actions are the four scroll directions, navigate_back , navigate_home , wait and one open_app , whose argument is the longest training-vocabulary app name in the goal or instruction. A ground-truth click or long-press is mapped to the smallest enumerated candidate that contains its coordinate, whereas the original benchmark takes the smallest a11y node of any kind; the click rule itself (the chosen candidate’s centre inside the ground-truth box) is unchanged. When no candidate contains the coordinate the step is unmapped and counts as an error for our policy (the original benchmark discards such steps). The mapped fraction is 97.4–98.4% on the test subsplits (IDD 98.0%, 2,405 of 2,454 click and long-press steps; full test 97.6%, 4,961 of 5,083), 98.8% on validation and 98.4% on the training split. An IDD step has 23.6 a11y candidates on average (median 18, p95 57; 22.2 on the full test set and 23.2 on the training split), and the 80-candidate cap is reached on 16 IDD, 22 full-test and 272 training steps. paragraphs.en: A step is correct under our exact-match judge when the predicted action type equals the ground-truth type and the argument matches: a click when the centre of the chosen candidate lies inside the ground-truth element box, which is the click rule of the original benchmark ( Li et al., 2024 , App. D.3) ; an input_text when the typed string equals the ground-truth string after normalisation; open_app and scroll when the argument matches exactly. The judge departs from the original protocol in four places, in both directions. (i) It is stricter in accepting no equivalent actions, whereas the original protocol treats open_app and a click on an element bearing the app name as equivalent, and likewise navigate_back and a click on the on-screen Back button. (ii) It is more lenient on input_text : it compares the normalised text only, whereas the original protocol scores typing as an element action that also requires the target element to lie inside the ground-truth box and the text to be identical. (iii) It is more lenient in accepting a click for a ground-truth long_press (9 IDD steps). (iv) It takes the ground-truth box from our enumerated candidates: a mapped click is judged against a box at least as large as the original’s smallest a11y node (more lenient), while an unmapped click counts as an error, where Li et al. (2024, App. D.1) discard it (stricter). On click steps, 62.7% of IDD steps, both judges thus apply the same centre-in-box rule. The AC-High gains transfer: on the three OOD subsplits the span ranker adds 2.08–2.76 points, and the click reranker adds 1.04–1.17 on the full test set, the OOD union and every OOD subsplit, at least its 0.98 on IDD. paragraphs.en: Table 9 shows that the deployed predictor is a poor forward model: its output is further from the true next latent than a copy of the current latent, and its predicted change has near-zero cosine to the true change and points the right way at chance rate. Feeding a shuffled action leaves the predicted latent at cosine 0.86 to the true-action prediction (IDD). The randomly initialised predictor of Table 8 (150 IDD episodes, 782 steps) is no more action-sensitive: its predicted change has cosine 0.002 to the true change, its ground-truth AUC equals the deployed predictor’s (0.5426 vs 0.5425; chance 0.5), and a shuffled action leaves its output at cosine 0.887 (0.954 for a within-type shuffle, probed for this predictor only). Free-running K K -step rollouts of the dynamics-pretrained predictor that initialises the deployed one (400 episodes; 1,500 / 1,500 / 1,349 queries at K = 1 K{=}1 / 2 / 3), scored by cosine to the true latent K K steps ahead, never beat persistence (keeping 𝐳 t \mathbf{z}_{t} ): 0.745 against 0.793 at K = 1 K{=}1 (0.733 with shuffled actions), 0.510 against 0.749 at K = 2 K{=}2 and 0.322 against 0.741 at K = 3 K{=}3 . The rollout beats persistence on 39 / 10 / 2% of steps and a shuffled-action rollout on only 43 / 48 / 49%; only within-episode retrieval of the true frame at K = 1 K{=}1 slightly favours it (R@5 79.7 vs 77.2 for persistence). paragraphs.en: The concat-MLP head trades AC-Low for AC-High accuracy: against the structural head it loses AC-Low and gains AC-High points with the ROI-conditioned predictor, and likewise loses 7.3 Low and gains 8.8 High with an ( x , y ) (x,y) -conditioned predictor (40.51 / 18.43 vs 33.18 / 27.19). paragraphs.zh: 拼接-MLP 头以 AC-Low 准确率换取 AC-High 准确率：与结构化头相比，在使用 ROI 条件化预测器时它损失了 AC-Low 得分、获得了 AC-High 得分，在使用 ( x , y ) (x,y) 条件化预测器时同样损失 7.3 的 Low、获得 8.8 的 High（40.51 / 18.43 对 33.18 / 27.19）。 无论使用哪种预测器或不使用预测器，它的 AC-Low 准确率都相同（图 4b），因此它获得的提升并非通过预测器实现；而结构化头在预测器被替换为恒等映射时，从 40.59 下降到 31.73。 我们保留结构化头，因为它迫使策略经过候选条件化的潜在表示；拼接头在试点规模上更高的 High 得分表明，这一约束在该规模下是有代价的。 我们采用了将结构化头条件化于先前动作和帧变化（隐式动作历史）的做法：在不使用文本匹配器时，它在试点规模上获得 8.0 的 High（23.35 提升到 31.39，代价是 4.4 的 Low）；在使用文本匹配器时获得 7.1 的 High（31.91 提升到 38.96，− 1.6 -1.6 Low）；最终系统在匹配器查询中将其与文本动作历史一起使用。

paragraphs.en: Predictive auxiliary losses on the predictor do not help ( Table 8 , bottom). Our SIGReg-style regulariser simplifies SIGReg ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) : where LeJEPA uses the Epps–Pulley statistic, it penalises the mean and variance of 256 random projections of the pooled predicted latents, and it acts on frozen encoder features, whereas LeWorldModel ( Maes et al., 2026 ) trains end to end.
paragraphs.zh: 在预测器上使用预测性辅助损失并没有帮助（表8，下方）。 无泄漏的池化下一潜在变量MSE均值较低，是因为其三次运行中有一次发生了坍塌；其余两次与其配对的对照组相差不到1.3分。 我们采用SIGReg风格的正则化器对SIGReg（Balestriero和LeCun，2025）进行了简化：LeJEPA使用Epps–Pulley统计量，而它则对池化预测潜在变量的256个随机投影的均值和方差进行惩罚，并且它作用于冻结的编码器特征，而LeWorldModel（Maes等人，2026）则是端到端训练的。

paragraphs.en: LiMAC ( Christianos et al., 2025 ) is the closest small agent that also consumes the UI tree: an action transformer (AcT, ≈ \approx 520M) over UI-element embeddings combined with Florence-2 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) (820M as deployed by LiMAC), which receives the screenshot annotated with numbered element boxes and the goal. Its overall accuracy is a goal-conditioned per-step action accuracy, the analogue of our AC-High setting, under its own judge (a predicted element whose box lies within the target element is correct, typed text is accepted at a Jaccard index of at least 0.5) on “the test set”, with no sub-split or size given; its confusion matrix sums to 3,708 steps, matching none of the official sub-splits. LiMAC and Florence-2 alone are 10.3 and 4.2 points above our 3-seed mean full-test High (9.3 and 3.2 above seed 3) with 2.7 × \times and 1.6 × \times our parameters, and its fine-tuned Qwen2-VL-2B baseline is 0.65 below our mean with 4.0 × \times our parameters; LiMAC’s more lenient text rule and unstated split keep the comparison approximate. LiMAC reports 0.34 s per step (Florence-2 alone: 0.50 s) on unspecified hardware, against our 51.5–74 ms per real step on one H20 ( Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: LiMAC（Christianos 等，2025）是最接近的、同样消费 UI 树的小型智能体：它在 UI 元素嵌入上使用动作 transformer（AcT，约 \approx 520M），并与 Florence-2（Xiao 等，2024）（LiMAC 部署时为 820M）结合，后者接收带有编号元素框标注的截图和目标。 其总体准确率是目标条件下的逐步动作准确率，对应我们的 AC-High 设置，在它自己的评判标准下（预测元素的框位于目标元素内即为正确，输入文本的 Jaccard 指数不低于 0.5 即被接受）于“测试集”上评估，未给出子集划分或规模；其混淆矩阵总计 3,708 步，与任何官方子集划分都不匹配。 LiMAC 以及单独的 Florence-2 分别比我们 3 个种子在全测试集 High 上的均值高 10.3 和 4.2 个百分点（比种子 3 高 9.3 和 3.2 个百分点），参数量分别是我们的 2.7 倍和 1.6 倍，其微调的 Qwen2-VL-2B 基线比我们的均值低 0.65，参数量是我们的 4.0 倍；LiMAC 更宽松的文本规则和未说明的划分使该对比只能是大致的。 LiMAC 报告每步 0.34 秒（单独的 Florence-2：0.50 秒），但未说明硬件，而我们在一块 H20 上每个真实步骤耗时 51.5–74 毫秒（附录 I）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 compares pretraining recipes for the frozen encoder by a localisation probe on its patch tokens: a linear scorer per patch, a softmax over the 14 × 14 14\times 14 grid and a soft-argmax give a point that is regressed (MSE) onto the centre of the target box; the encoder is fixed and only the probe is trained. hit@ k k is the fraction of held-out examples whose predicted point lies within k / 14 k/14 of the image side (normalised Euclidean distance) of the target centre, so hit@8 accepts errors of up to 128 px on the 224-px input. The probe is lenient: on the 1,581 held-out ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) examples the policy encoder’s hit@8 of 67.22 ± \pm 0.91 comes with a hit@3 of 10.36 ± \pm 0.36, a hit@1 of 0.92 ± \pm 0.36 and a mean error of 0.509 of the image side (114 px); on 255 ScreenSpot-v2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) examples it reaches 90.59 ± \pm 1.00 hit@8 with a mean error of 0.378 of the side (85 px). For calibration, under the same probe a randomly initialised ViT-L reaches 87.8 hit@8 on the same ScreenSpot-v2 split and 58.8 [56.4, 61.2] on ScreenSpot-Pro, and an ImageNet-initialised ViT-L without GUI pretraining 58.1. The probe thus measures coarse localisation.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 通过对冻结编码器的补丁标记（patch tokens）进行定位探针测试，比较了各预训练方案：对每个补丁使用线性打分器，在 14 × 14 14\times 14 网格上做 softmax 并经 soft-argmax 得到一个点，再用均方误差（MSE）将其回归到目标框的中心；编码器保持固定，只训练探针。hit@ k k 是指held-out样本中预测点落在距目标中心不超过图像边长 k / 14 k/14（归一化欧氏距离）范围内的比例，因此 hit@8 在 224 像素的输入上可接受最多 128 像素的误差。 该探针较为宽松：在 1,581 个held-out的 ScreenSpot-Pro（Li et al., 2025）样本上，策略编码器的 hit@8 为 67.22 ± \pm 0.91，同时 hit@3 为 10.36 ± \pm 0.36，hit@1 为 0.92 ± \pm 0.36，平均误差为图像边长的 0.509（114 像素）；在 255 个 ScreenSpot-v2（Wu et al., 2025）样本上，它达到 90.59 ± \pm 1.00 的 hit@8，平均误差为边长的 0.378（85 像素）。 作为校准参照，在相同探针下，随机初始化的 ViT-L 在同一 ScreenSpot-v2 划分上达到 87.8 的 hit@8，在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上为 58.8 [56.4, 61.2]，而没有经过 GUI 预训练、以 ImageNet 初始化的 ViT-L 为 58.1。 因此，该探针衡量的是粗粒度定位能力。

paragraphs.en: We hashed the 9,987 screenshots of the 1,543 AndroidControl test episodes (pHash and dHash, 64 bits) against the 189,262 pretraining screenshots (118,791 GUI-Odyssey, 70,471 VideoCUA). 58 test frames (0.58%) in 43 episodes have a verified near-duplicate (pHash distance ≤ 8 \leq 8 and normalised cross-correlation ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 ), all from GUI-Odyssey and showing generic system screens. For calibration, the same pHash threshold matches 35.0% of test frames to the frames of 4,000 AndroidControl training episodes (different episodes of the same benchmark) and 9.5% to the pretraining set; random pairs have a median distance of 32. Removing the 43 episodes changes final High and Low by − 0.2 -0.2 (High 59.90 vs 60.12 on IDD, 52.64 vs 52.85 on the full test). Removing every episode with any pHash match within distance 8 (549 episodes), a criterion that also flags generic layouts, gives 58.74 IDD and 51.14 full-test High. At the app level, 29 app names match exactly and 26% of test episodes touch a package that also appears in GUI-Odyssey, with different devices and tasks and no shared screenshots. Pretraining–test leakage is thus negligible for the reported numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 1,543 个 AndroidControl 测试回合的 9,987 张截图（pHash 和 dHash，64 位）与 189,262 张预训练截图（118,791 张 GUI-Odyssey，70,471 张 VideoCUA）进行了比对。43 个回合中的 58 张测试帧（0.58%）存在经验证的近似重复（pHash 距离 ≤ 8 \leq 8 且归一化互相关 ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9），全部来自 GUI-Odyssey，且显示的是通用系统界面。 作为校准，同样的 pHash 阈值将 35.0% 的测试帧匹配到 4,000 个 AndroidControl 训练回合的帧（同一基准的不同回合），9.5% 匹配到预训练集；随机对的距离中位数为 32。 移除这 43 个回合后，最终 High 和 Low 变化 − 0.2 -0.2（IDD 上 High 为 59.90 对 60.12，完整测试集上为 52.64 对 52.85）。 移除所有存在 pHash 距离 8 以内匹配的回合（549 个回合）——这一标准同样会标记通用布局——得到 IDD High 为 58.74，完整测试集 High 为 51.14。 在应用层面，29 个应用名称完全匹配，26% 的测试回合涉及也出现在 GUI-Odyssey 中的应用包，但设备与任务不同，且没有共享的截图。 因此，预训练与测试之间的数据泄漏对所报告的数值而言可以忽略不计。

paragraphs.en: All candidates of a step form one predictor batch. The residual form was chosen in IDD pilots without the text matcher: a predictor that re-synthesises the whole latent erases local detail, lowering AC-Low click grounding to 34.8 against 46.8 for the identity map, and the residual form raises pilot AC-Low from 40.59 to 43.93. At pilot scale (IDD) the structural head’s constraint, that its only candidate-dependent visual input is the candidate-conditioned latent, decides whether the pathway is used: a concat-MLP head over [ 𝐳 t , 𝐳 ~ t c , cand ] [\mathbf{z}_{t},\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{t}^{c},\mathrm{cand}] ignores the predictor (within 1.4 AC-Low points), while the structural head gains 8.8 points ( Figure 4 b; Appendix E ). The conditioning vector uses the frozen CLIP text embedding ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . The MiniLM-L12 text matcher ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) carries most of the click grounding: in the pilot, grounding rose from 37.4 to 70.2 when it was added. The input_text argument is copied as a goal span, which can be correct on at most 81.6% of IDD input_text steps.
paragraphs.zh: 一个步骤的所有候选构成一个预测器批次。 残差形式是在没有文本匹配器的 IDD 试点中选定的：重新合成整个潜在表示的预测器会抹除局部细节，使 AC-Low 点击定位降至 34.8，而恒等映射为 46.8；残差形式则将试点 AC-Low 从 40.59 提升至 43.93。 在试点规模（IDD）下，结构头这一约束——即其唯一依赖候选的视觉输入是候选条件化的潜在表示——决定了该通路是否被使用：对 [ 𝐳 t , 𝐳 ~ t c , cand ] [\mathbf{z}_{t},\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{t}^{c},\mathrm{cand}] 使用 concat-MLP 头的智能体会忽略预测器（相差 1.4 个 AC-Low 点以内），而结构头则获得 8.8 个点的提升（图 4 b；附录 E）。 条件向量使用冻结的 CLIP 文本嵌入（Radford et al., 2021）。 MiniLM-L12 文本匹配器（Wang et al., 2020；Reimers and Gurevych, 2019）承担了大部分点击定位任务：在试点中，加入它后定位从 37.4 提升至 70.2。 input_text 参数被复制为目标片段，这在 IDD 的 input_text 步骤中最多只能在 81.6% 的情况下是正确的。

sents.zh: 残差形式是在没有文本匹配器的 IDD 试点中选定的：重新合成整个潜在表示的预测器会抹除局部细节，使 AC-Low 点击定位降至 34.8，而恒等映射为 46.8；残差形式则将试点 AC-Low 从 40.59 提升至 43.93。

sents.en: At pilot scale (IDD) the structural head’s constraint, that its only candidate-dependent visual input is the candidate-conditioned latent, decides whether the pathway is used: a concat-MLP head over [ 𝐳 t , 𝐳 ~ t c , cand ] [\mathbf{z}_{t},\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{t}^{c},\mathrm{cand}] ignores the predictor (within 1.4 AC-Low points), while the structural head gains 8.8 points ( Figure 4 b; Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 在试点规模（IDD）下，结构头这一约束——即其唯一依赖候选的视觉输入是候选条件化的潜在表示——决定了该通路是否被使用：对 [ 𝐳 t , 𝐳 ~ t c , cand ] [\mathbf{z}_{t},\tilde{\mathbf{z}}_{t}^{c},\mathrm{cand}] 使用 concat-MLP 头的智能体会忽略预测器（相差 1.4 个 AC-Low 点以内），而结构头则获得 8.8 个点的提升（图 4 b；附录 E）。

sents.en: The conditioning vector uses the frozen CLIP text embedding ( Radford et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 条件向量使用冻结的 CLIP 文本嵌入（Radford et al., 2021）。

sents.en: The MiniLM-L12 text matcher ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) carries most of the click grounding: in the pilot, grounding rose from 37.4 to 70.2 when it was added.
sents.zh: MiniLM-L12 文本匹配器（Wang et al., 2020；Reimers and Gurevych, 2019）承担了大部分点击定位任务：在试点中，加入它后定位从 37.4 提升至 70.2。

sents.en: The input_text argument is copied as a goal span, which can be correct on at most 81.6% of IDD input_text steps.
sents.zh: input_text 参数被复制为目标片段，这在 IDD 的 input_text 步骤中最多只能在 81.6% 的情况下是正确的。

paragraphs.en: Training skips the 1.6% of training click steps whose ground-truth element is not enumerated. Neither text ranker changes the action-type decision of the base policy, but both act in AC-Low as well as AC-High ( Appendix C ).

paragraphs.en: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) (8.29B parameters, measured) is fine-tuned with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on 4,000 of the 13,594 cached training episodes for one epoch, with one adapter per setting (3.5 / 4.4 GPU-h for High / Low on one H20); the AC-Low adapter’s prompt adds the step instruction to the goal and shares every other setting, whereas GUI-JEPA serves both settings with one model. It is prompted with the same screenshot (377 image tokens; at most 384 visual tokens), the same enumerated candidate list and the same ground-truth history as GUI-JEPA, decodes a JSON action greedily, and is scored by the byte-identical judge on the same 716 IDD episodes. Beyond Table 14 , the High adapter reaches a click top-5 recall of 95.3, and the AC-Low adapter reaches 91.01 Low with type accuracy 97.4 (GUI-JEPA: 84.06, 92.4% of it). We report click grounding in two forms because the conditional form alone rewards predicting fewer clicks: our seed with the lowest type accuracy (74.9) has the highest conditional grounding (76.1). The 7B agent leads on every action type of Table 14 except wait ; Table 15 converts the per-type differences into contributions to the overall gap. The fine-tuned number is close to published 7B SFT results on AndroidControl (69.7–71.2 High for Qwen2-VL-7B and OS-Atlas-7B fine-tuned on AndroidControl, Wu et al., 2025 , Tab. 5 ), which use the OS-Atlas judge on 7,708 test samples; under our judge and split it serves as the same-protocol reference.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct（Bai 等，2025）（8.29B 参数，实测）使用 LoRA（Hu 等，2022）在 13,594 条缓存训练回合中的 4,000 条上进行微调，训练一个 epoch，每种设置对应一个适配器（在单块 H20 上，High / Low 分别需 3.5 / 4.4 GPU 小时）；AC-Low 适配器的提示词在目标中加入了步骤指令，其余所有设置均相同，而 GUI-JEPA 则用一个模型同时服务两种设置。 它接收与 GUI-JEPA 相同的截图（377 个图像 token；最多 384 个视觉 token）、相同的枚举候选列表和相同的真实历史记录，以贪心方式解码出 JSON 动作，并由字节完全一致的裁判在同样的 716 条 IDD 回合上进行评分。 除表 14 之外，High 适配器的点击 top-5 召回率达到 95.3，AC-Low 适配器达到 91.01 Low，打字准确率为 97.4（GUI-JEPA：84.06，为其 92.4%）。 我们以两种形式报告点击定位，因为仅用条件形式会奖励预测更少的点击：我们打字准确率最低的种子（74.9）反而拥有最高的条件定位准确率（76.1）。 除 wait 之外，该 7B 智能体在表 14 的每种动作类型上都领先；表 15 将各类型的差异转化为对整体差距的贡献。 该微调结果接近已发表的 7B SFT 在 AndroidControl 上的结果（在 AndroidControl 上微调的 Qwen2-VL-7B 和 OS-Atlas-7B 的 High 为 69.7–71.2，Wu 等，2025，表 5），后者在 7,708 个测试样本上使用 OS-Atlas 裁判；在我们的裁判和数据划分下，它可作为同协议的参考基准。

paragraphs.en: The Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent is timed on the first 110 AC-High IDD test steps in test-set order (10 warm-up, 100 measured) with the prompt of its accuracy evaluation: the screenshot at a 377-token image budget, the goal, the ground-truth history and the enumerated candidate list in the Qwen chat template, 931 input tokens on average. It decodes greedily until the end-of-sequence token and emits 11.75 new tokens on average, its most favourable configuration. End to end, including CPU prompt preparation (chat template, image processor, tokenisation), HF transformers 4.57 in bf16 with flash-attention 2 needs 506.7 ms per step for the merged LoRA-SFT model (generation alone 499.1 ms; prefill 189 ms, decode 28.3 ms per token), 504.6 ms for the zero-shot base model (p90 580.6; prefill 187 ms, 27.5 ms per token; 15.9 GB peak) and 753.6 ms for the unmerged LoRA model used in the accuracy evaluation (p90 889.3; prefill 229 ms, 47.8 ms per token; 16.2 GB). Merging is the deployment configuration, so our ratios use the merged model. With vLLM 0.11.2 ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) in bf16 the merged model needs 206.7 ms end to end (generation alone 206.5 ms; prefill 96 ms, 10.2 ms per token) with prefix caching off, and 211.9 ms (p90 250) with prefix caching on, where the 15 ms prefill and 18.5 ms per token reflect the cached system prefix.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen2.5-VL-7B 智能体按测试集顺序在前 110 个 AC-High IDD 测试步骤上进行计时（10 步预热、100 步正式测量），其提示词与精度评估所用一致：377-token 图像预算下的截图、目标、真实历史以及在 Qwen 聊天模板中枚举的候选列表，平均 931 个输入 token。 它以贪婪解码直到序列结束 token，平均生成 11.75 个新 token，这是其最有利的配置。 端到端来看，包括 CPU 提示词准备（聊天模板、图像处理器、分词）在内，bf16 精度下使用 flash-attention 2 的 HF transformers 4.57 对合并后的 LoRA-SFT 模型每步需要 506.7 ms（仅生成 499.1 ms；预填充 189 ms，解码每 token 28.3 ms），零样本基座模型为 504.6 ms（p90 580.6；预填充 187 ms，每 token 27.5 ms；峰值 15.9 GB），用于精度评估的未合并 LoRA 模型为 753.6 ms（p90 889.3；预填充 229 ms，每 token 47.8 ms；16.2 GB）。 合并是部署配置，因此我们的比率使用合并后的模型。 使用 bf16 精度的 vLLM 0.11.2（Kwon et al., 2023）时，合并后的模型在关闭前缀缓存的情况下端到端需要 206.7 ms（仅生成 206.5 ms；预填充 96 ms，每 token 10.2 ms），开启前缀缓存时为 211.9 ms（p90 250），其中 15 ms 的预填充和每 token 18.5 ms 反映了被缓存的系统前缀。

paragraphs.en: We time the final pipeline end to end on the first 210 AC-High IDD test steps in test-set order (10 warm-up, 200 measured, 46 episodes), so the 7B agent’s 100 measured steps are a subset of ours. Each step executes the full pipeline, with the span ranker only on steps predicted as input_text (10% of steps) and the click reranker only on steps predicted as click (63.5%). The 200 steps have 24.4 a11y candidates on average (median 18, p90 49) and 33.0 scored actions (median 28.5, p90 58). The served policy is the evaluated policy: its base-policy action matches the offline evaluation, which uses precomputed encoder features, on 198 of the 200 steps (99.0%), and on all 200 when both receive the same preprocessed frames. On the 200 steps the bf16 and fp32 pipelines make identical predictions, including the typed text. On all IDD steps, the base policy (base stage of Table 2 ) changes by + 0.18 +0.18 Low / − 0.07 -0.07 High in bf16 relative to fp32, with 99.8% step-level agreement on type, candidate and direction. The typed string agrees on 151 of the 322 High steps where both predict input_text ; that ranker is rarely right in High, and High input_text accuracy moves from 15.6 to 14.2 (4 of 282 steps).
paragraphs.zh: 我们按测试集顺序，在前 210 个 AC-High IDD 测试步骤（10 个预热步骤、200 个测量步骤、46 个片段）上对最终流水线进行端到端计时，因此 7B 智能体的 100 个测量步骤是我们测量步骤的子集。 每个步骤都执行完整流水线，其中跨度排序器仅在预测为 input_text 的步骤上运行（占 10% 的步骤），点击重排序器仅在预测为 click 的步骤上运行（占 63.5%）。 这 200 个步骤平均有 24.4 个无障碍候选（中位数 18，p90 为 49），以及 33.0 个评分动作（中位数 28.5，p90 为 58）。 所服务的策略即被评估的策略：其基础策略动作与使用预计算编码器特征的离线评估在 200 个步骤中的 198 个上一致（99.0%），并且在两者接收相同预处理帧时在全部 200 个步骤上一致。 在这 200 个步骤上，bf16 与 fp32 流水线做出完全相同的预测，包括输入的类型化文本。 在所有 IDD 步骤上，基础策略（表 2 的 base 阶段）在 bf16 下相对 fp32 变化为 +0.18 Low / −0.07 High，在类型、候选和方向上的步骤级一致率为 99.8%。 在双方都预测为 input_text 的 322 个 High 步骤中，类型化文本在 151 个步骤上一致；该排序器在 High 上很少正确，High 的 input_text 准确率从 15.6 降到 14.2（282 个步骤中的 4 个）。

paragraphs.en: Over the 200 steps, the fp32 p50 decomposes into 8.3 ms JPEG decoding and resizing (9.6% of the mean), 11.4 ms ViT-L (13.0%), 1.2 ms candidate construction, 1.2 ms ROI encoding, 39.7 ms predictor and structural head (51.4%), 8.8 ms matcher (12.7%), 8.1 ms click reranker when it fires (6.8%) and 21.5 ms span ranker when it fires (3.3%); in bf16 the p50 components are 7.0 ms decoding, 7.7 ms ViT-L, 11.8 ms predictor and head and 10.4 ms matcher. By a11y candidate count the fp32 p50 is 58.9 ms below 15 candidates, 74.5 at 15–29, 125.1 at 30–59 and 168.7 at 60 or more. The CLIP goal embedding runs once per episode and is not included: its median is 5.6 ms (mean 10.8 ms, raised by one 245 ms first call), about 1.3 ms per step amortised at the median and 2.4 ms at the mean. In AC-Low the step instruction changes at every step, so the CLIP call recurs per step; all real-step timings are AC-High.

paragraphs.en: The synthetic rows of Table 16 and the lines of Figure 8 time the final pipeline in eager PyTorch on a random 224-px image tensor with random action and ROI vectors and dummy candidate texts and bounds, 100-iteration median. N N counts the scored actions in the predictor batch, that is, a11y candidates plus global actions. N = 23 N{=}23 and 57 equal the mean and p95 a11y candidate counts of IDD, but a real step scores more actions than it has a11y candidates (33.0 against 24.4 on average on the timed steps), so the synthetic N = 23 N{=}23 point understates a typical step and the real-step rows are the operating point. The encoder cost is fixed, and the predictor batch grows by about 1.2 ms per scored action in fp32 and 0.37 ms in bf16; torch.compile on top of bf16 lowers the bf16 times by a further 0.7–6.6%. The benchmark’s inputs are not real screenshots, so it only shows the linear scaling in N N .
paragraphs.zh: 表16的合成行与图8的曲线测量的是最终流水线在即时模式PyTorch中的耗时，输入为随机的224像素图像张量、随机的动作与ROI向量，以及占位的候选文本和边界框，取100次迭代的 中位数。 N N 表示预测器批次中被评分的动作数量，即无障碍候选动作加上全局动作。 N = 23 N{=}23 和57分别对应IDD的无障碍候选数量的均值和p95，但真实步骤评分的动作数量多于其无障碍候选数量（在计时步骤上平均为33.0对24.4），因此合成的 N = 23 N{=}23 数据点低估了典型步骤的耗时，真实步骤的行才是实际运行点。 编码器开销是固定的，预测器批次每增加一个被评分动作约增加1.2毫秒（fp32）和0.37毫秒（bf16）；在bf16基础上使用torch.compile可再将bf16耗时降低0.7–6.6%。 该基准测试的输入并非真实截图，因此它只展示了随 N N 的线性扩展关系。

paragraphs.en: 8B-class GUI agents average 2.6–10.6 s per step in a live-device benchmark ( Sui et al., 2026 , Tab. 2 ; means over valid sessions, BF16 on H20 GPUs with the GPU count and serving engine not stated, each model under its official inference protocol where one is released). V-Droid reports 0.7 s per decision, covering all candidates of a step (0.44 s batched prefill verification plus 0.30 s action completion), and 4.3 s per step end to end, 3.03 s of it in a GPT-4 working-memory update (verifier on two RTX 4090 GPUs; Dai et al., 2026 ). Neither shares our measurement boundary or statistic (means over live-device sessions with model-specific prompts and outputs, against our median over 100 real test steps).
paragraphs.zh: 8B 级别的 GUI 智能体在真实设备基准测试中平均每步耗时 2.6–10.6 秒（Sui 等，2026，表 2；为有效会话的均值，在 H20 GPU 上以 BF16 运行，GPU 数量与推理服务引擎未说明，各模型采用其已发布的官方推理协议（如有））。 V-Droid 报告每次决策 0.7 秒，覆盖一步的全部候选（0.44 秒的批量预填充验证加上 0.30 秒的动作补全），端到端每步 4.3 秒，其中 3.03 秒用于 GPT-4 的工作记忆更新（验证器运行在两块 RTX 4090 GPU 上；Dai 等，2026）。 两者的测量边界或统计口径均与我们不同（它们是对真实设备会话使用模型特定提示词与输出的均值，而我们是基于 100 个真实测试步骤的中位数）。

paragraphs.en: GUI-JEPA and the same-protocol 7B agent err on different steps ( Figure 10 ): on IDD AC-High at least one of them is right on 78.9% of steps on average over the three GUI-JEPA seeds (78.7–79.2), against 70.87 for the 7B agent and 60.12 for GUI-JEPA. We therefore test GUI-JEPA as the cheap first stage of a cascade: a step is answered by GUI-JEPA when the margin between its top two final scores is at least τ \tau and escalated to the 7B SFT agent otherwise. The margin predicts whether GUI-JEPA is correct with AUROC 0.74–0.77, and on its most confident half of the steps GUI-JEPA alone is 77.6–79.2% accurate. Setting τ \tau at coverage quantiles (the share of steps kept by GUI-JEPA) traces the curve of Figure 11 (main-text model). At 50% coverage the cascade reaches 69.48 High on average over seeds, 98% of the 7B agent’s 70.87, at 0.91 × \times its mean vLLM latency with fp32 GUI-JEPA and 0.76 × \times with bf16 (with HF serving, 86.9 + 0.5 × 515.7 ≈ 345 86.9+0.5\times 515.7\approx 345 ms against 515.7 ms, 0.67 × \times ). Because τ \tau is set on coverage quantiles of the same IDD steps, we report the cascade as a deployment mode. For the main-text model the margin AUROC is 0.74, at least one system is right on 78.7% of steps, and the 50%-coverage cascade reaches 69.67 (98% of 70.87) at the same expected latency, with GUI-JEPA 78.1% accurate on the steps it keeps.
paragraphs.zh: GUI-JEPA 与相同协议的 7B 智能体在不同步骤上出错（图 10）：在 IDD AC-High 上，对三个 GUI-JEPA 种子取平均，至少其中一个在 78.9% 的步骤上正确（78.7–79.2），而 7B 智能体为 70.87，GUI-JEPA 为 60.12。 因此我们测试将 GUI-JEPA 作为级联的低成本第一阶段：当其最高两个最终得分之差至少为 τ \tau 时，该步骤由 GUI-JEPA 回答，否则升级给 7B SFT 智能体。 该分差预测 GUI-JEPA 是否正确的 AUROC 为 0.74–0.77，而在其最有把握的一半步骤上，仅 GUI-JEPA 的准确率即为 77.6–79.2%。 将 τ \tau 设在覆盖率的分位数上（即由 GUI-JEPA 保留的步骤占比），可以描绘出图 11 的曲线（正文模型）。 在 50% 覆盖率下，级联在各种子上的平均 High 得分为 69.48，是 7B 智能体 70.87 的 98%，延迟为其平均 vLLM 延迟的 0.91 × \times（fp32 GUI-JEPA）和 0.76 × \times（bf16）（使用 HF serving 时为 86.9 + 0.5 × 515.7 ≈ 345 86.9+0.5\times 515.7\approx 345 ms，对比 515.7 ms，即 0.67 × \times）。 由于 τ \tau 是在相同的 IDD 步骤的覆盖率分位数上设定的，我们将该级联报告为一种部署模式。 对于正文模型，分差 AUROC 为 0.74，至少一个系统在 78.7% 的步骤上正确，且 50% 覆盖率的级联在相同预期延迟下达到 69.67（为 70.87 的 98%），GUI-JEPA 在其保留的步骤上的准确率为 78.1%。
